description: (Na)₂ScAgCl₆ is High-temperature superconductor-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. The structure consists of eight Na clusters inside a ScAgCl₆ framework. In each Na cluster, Na is bonded in a 12-coordinate geometry to  atoms. In the ScAgCl₆ framework, Sc is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form ScCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent AgCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Sc-Cl bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Ag is bonded to six equivalent Cl atoms to form AgCl₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ScCl₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Ag-Cl bond lengths are 2.69 Å. Cl is bonded in a linear geometry to one Sc and one Ag atom.
